identity.title: Run supported ordered Thickness recipes from the Shell

origin.kind: 2026-08-17 actual Release EXE ten-recipe UX study
origin.summary: The valid Thickness recipes Previewed and Published in the Shell and replayed in Runner, but the Shell full-Run command did not support the same ordered Thickness execution.

state.current_summary: The saved current recipe now runs explicitly in Studio through the shared ordered graph, writes Results-ready evidence, preserves no-auto-run boundaries, matches Runner across ten Thickness samples, and passes current UI and performance checks.

claims.text: The Shell explicit full-Run command does not execute a valid supported Thickness recipe that the production Runner replays deterministically.

problem.impact: The operator loop stops at Preview and Publish inside Studio and requires a separate Runner process to perform the recipe's explicit ordered Run.

criteria.text: Run is enabled for a valid supported Thickness recipe and unavailable with an exact reason for incomplete or unsupported recipes.
Shell Run status, metrics, ordered step identity, controlled output identity, and Run Record agree with Runner for Pass, Fail, and Error samples.
Run remains explicit and does not occur during edits, compatible-variant creation, Preview, Publish, layout changes, restore, save, or reopen.
Current Wide and Compact Run status and next-action evidence are themed, readable, bounded, and keyboard reachable.

context.summary: RunTeachingRecipeCommand currently owns the Shell full-Run eligibility and execution path.
Production Runner already replays the ten valid current-schema Thickness recipes deterministically.

evidence.kind: actual Release EXE and source-path confirmation
evidence.observation: During the ten-recipe actual Shell session, explicit Preview and Publish worked for Thickness but Ctrl+F5/full Run did not execute it. Source inspection confirms RunTeachingRecipeCommand eligibility and execution are owned by the filter-oriented path, while Runner replayed all ten Thickness recipes.

Studio exposes one saved-current-recipe Run command, uses ToolRecipeOrderedGraphExecution and the same ordered-step Run Record projection as Runner, writes schema 1.5 evidence, routes it into Results, and invalidates evidence on recipe edits without invoking Run from edit, Preview, Publish, save, or reopen.

The current Release executable passes 13/13 checks covering valid saved readiness, no automatic Run on open/Preview/Publish/save/reopen, Pass/Fail/Error record projection, exact metric and identity parity, edit invalidation, and unsupported-step reason.

evidence.kind: actual Release EXE Wide and Compact UI evidence
evidence.observation: Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 ready and held pointer-down captures are accepted with selected-monitor intersection true. Latest-build direct clicks show readable Fail state, metric, output hash, saved Run Record, and linked Results with no overlap, required-text clipping, horizontal scrolling, or platform-light theme leak.

evidence.kind: ten-sample actual EXE parity and performance
evidence.observation: Ten fresh Release EXE processes exit successfully and match expected Pass 4 / Fail 5 / Error 1. Shell and production Runner status, metrics, step identity, output identity, and output content hash agree 10/10. Ordered duration is p50 468.425 ms, p95 533.351 ms, and max 533.351 ms, within the sample-class 600 ms p95 and 750 ms max guards.
The final solution Release build completes with zero warnings and zero errors; final ordered Run verification passes 13/13, final Shell option verification passes 40/40, and git diff --check passes.

events.summary: Resolved after the shared ordered Run path, Results-ready evidence, no-auto-run boundaries, ten-sample Runner parity, current Wide/Compact UI review, and final verification all passed.
